name: FPS
value_or_formula: 75 (cfg); code default 12 (variable.c:182, mdefines.h:46); timer interval = 1000000/cfg_fps us, catch-up loop

name: tick
value_or_formula: one dungeon() call = 1 turn.turn increment

name: level_speed(d)
value_or_formula: 5*level_speeds[max(d,0)]; d=0/wilderness uses level_speeds[0]=7500

name: level_speeds[]
value_or_formula: see char_level_speeds.csv (tables.c:2202-2216); level_speed(d)=level_speeds[d]*5

name: extract_energy[110]
value_or_formula: 1000 (index = pspeed; 110=normal; +10 speed=2000; <=69 =100; table 200 entries)

name: ticks_per_player_turn
value_or_formula: level_speed(d)/extract_energy[pspeed] at tf=100 (normal speed: level_speed/1000)

name: energy_gain_per_tick
value_or_formula: int(extract_energy[pspeed]*bubble_speed/100); town running: extra *5; cap energy<=level_speed

name: energy_cost_move_walk_run_step
value_or_formula: level_speed(d)

name: energy_cost_blow
value_or_formula: level_speed(d)/num_blow per blow; attacks repeat while energy>=blow_energy

name: energy_cost_fire
value_or_formula: level_speed(d)/num_fire

name: energy_cost_throw_use_read_quaff_eat_cast_stairs_open_disarm_search
value_or_formula: level_speed(d)

name: energy_cost_half_turn
value_or_formula: level_speed(d)/2

name: energy_cost_wield_destroy_dropgold_steal
value_or_formula: level_speed(d)

name: energy_cost_start_rest
value_or_formula: level_speed(d); energy then forced to 0 each tick while resting

name: rest_refused_if
value_or_formula: poisoned OR (chp==mhp AND csp==msp)

name: CONSTANT_TIME_FACTOR
value_or_formula: 5 defined -> if chp*100/mhp <= hitpoint_warn*10 then tf=100/5=20 (not proportional)

name: hitpoint_warn_default_tool_mode
value_or_formula: 6 (client --hpwarn 0..9) => slow below 60% HP; NOTE the Pilot launches with --hpwarn 0 (pilot.py:5135-5141), so the low-HP bubble is OFF

name: tf_reset_rule
value_or_formula: if hitpoint_warn>9 and no awake monster/hostile player in LOS: tf=100

name: tf_rest
value_or_formula: 1000 if resting and no AWAKE monster or hostile player in line of sight - SEEN OR NOT (monsters_in_los: mon_los && !csleep ; xtra2.c:5116-5148); right after a fight usually false; set-piece L2 2026-10-24 measured 1x (overrides low-HP slow)

name: tf_run
value_or_formula: 500 if running and no awake monster in LOS (seen or not; see tf_rest)

name: tf_town
value_or_formula: time_factor() returns 100 in town (depth 0); BUT process_player_end uses base_time_factor (no town exemption) for regen/timeouts

name: tf_multi_player
value_or_formula: slowest bubble within MAX_SIGHT=20 of any player at same depth (recursive); other players with tf==100 and no LOS count as 1000

name: monster_energy_gain
value_or_formula: int(extract_energy[mspeed]*time_factor(closest player)/100); cap level_speed; acts when >= level_speed

name: monster_speed_variance
value_or_formula: non-unique mspeed += rand_spread(0,(extract_energy[speed]/100)/10); start energy randint0(level_speed(0))

name: MONSTER_RECOIL
value_or_formula: default TRUE: after a monster melee-attacks a player it loses another level_speed energy (skips ~1 extra turn)

name: ENERGY_BUILDUP
value_or_formula: default TRUE: unused energy above level_speed carries (max another level_speed); reset to 0 on walk, run, rest-toggle

name: game_tick_block_interval
value_or_formula: time = int(int(level_speed(d)/1000) / (tf/100.0)) ticks; block runs when turn%time==0

name: regen_hp_per_event
value_or_formula: new=mhp*pct+1442; heal new>>16 plus carry of low 16 bits (chp_frac)

name: regen_pct
value_or_formula: 197 normal; 98 if food<1000; 33 if food<500; 0 if food<100; x2 regenerate; x2 resting or searching; 0 if poisoned or cut

name: regen_mana_per_event
value_or_formula: msp*pct+524 same scheme (pct not zeroed by poison/cut)

name: food_burn_per_event
value_or_formula: i=(extract_energy[pspeed]/100)*2 (+30 regenerate, -10 slow_digest); event every 10*time ticks; gorged(>=15000): 100
applies_when: dungeon depth>0 and not special level

name: food_thresholds
value_or_formula: MAX 15000, FULL 10000, ALERT 2000, WEAK 1000, FAINT 500, STARVE 100; start 9999; set_food cap 20000

name: faint
value_or_formula: below 500: 10%/event paralyzed 1+randint0(5); starve<100: dmg (100-food)/10 per event

name: food_values
value_or_formula: Ration 5000, Slime Mold 3000, Waybread 7500, Hard Biscuit 500, Ale 500

name: light_burn
value_or_formula: pval-- once per block (= per time ticks) for torch/lantern; not artifact/Dwarven/Feanor

name: torch_max_lantern_max
value_or_formula: FUEL_TORCH 5000, FUEL_LAMP 15000; store torch 2500, store lantern 7500; floor torch randint1(4000), lantern randint1(7500); flask +7500; torch merge +pval+5

name: light_radius
value_or_formula: torch 1 (while pval>0), lantern 2, dwarven 2, feanor 3

name: timed_decrement
value_or_formula: every timed effect -1 per block (same clock as light/recall/regen)

name: dur_heroism_potion
value_or_formula: hero += randint1(25)+25 ; heal 10; cures fear

name: dur_berserk_potion
value_or_formula: shero += randint1(25)+25 ; heal 30

name: dur_speed_potion
value_or_formula: fast = randint1(25)+15 if not fast else fast+5

name: dur_bless_scroll
value_or_formula: Blessing randint1(12)+6; Holy Chant randint1(24)+12; Holy Prayer randint1(48)+24

name: dur_prot_evil_scroll
value_or_formula: protevil += randint1(25)+3*plev

name: dur_resist_heat_cold_potion
value_or_formula: randint1(10)+10

name: dur_infravision_detect_invis_potion
value_or_formula: infra 100+randint1(100); invis 12+randint1(12)

name: recall_delay
value_or_formula: word_recall = randint0(20)+15 = 15..34 blocks; counts down once per block; activation postponed 1 block if in a store

name: recall_seconds
value_or_formula: word_recall*time/FPS where time=int(int(level_speed/1000)/(tf/100)); tf=1000 resting with no awake monster in LOS (seen or not) -> ~10x faster; NOT after a fight with one awake in the dark (L2: 15-16 s resting = standing)

name: recall_depth
value_or_formula: default max_dlv; @R<n> inscription: n (if n%50==0 then n/50); if n>max_dlv or n==0 -> max_dlv; unvisited wilderness -> 1; read in dungeon -> town

name: max_dlv_update
value_or_formula: max_dlv = max(max_dlv, Depth) on arrival

name: MAX_DEPTH
value_or_formula: 128 (stairs stop at 127)

name: store_maint_interval
value_or_formula: every 10*STORE_TURNS=2500 ticks (33.3 s at 75 FPS), all stores except 7,8, skipping a store with a player in it; shuffle 1 in 35

name: store_turnover
value_or_formula: sells randint1(9) stock slots (keeps 12..36) then buys randint1(9)

name: day_night
value_or_formula: full day = 10*TOWN_DAWN = 500000 ticks (6667 s=111 min at 75 FPS); IS_DAY first half (250000 ticks = 55.6 min)

name: server_save
value_or_formula: every cfg_fps*60*10 ticks (10 min)

name: unique_respawn
value_or_formula: disabled (#if 0)

name: pick_trap
value_or_formula: uniform over 16 types FEAT_TRAP_HEAD+randint0(16); no depth dependence; trap door rerolled on quest levels and depth>=127

name: traps_per_level
value_or_formula: randint1(k), k=clamp(Depth/3,2,10) (classic generator)

name: trap0_trapdoor
value_or_formula: 2d8 dmg unless feather fall; +1 level; no connected stair; no effect in wilderness/quest level

name: trap1_pit
value_or_formula: 2d6 (feather: none)

name: trap2_spiked_pit
value_or_formula: 2d6; 50%: dmg*2 and cut += randint1(dam)

name: trap3_poison_pit
value_or_formula: 2d6; 50%: dmg*2, cut += randint1(dam), poison += randint1(dam*2) unless resist

name: trap4_summon_rune
value_or_formula: summons 2+randint1(3) monsters at depth level; trap vanishes

name: trap5_teleport_rune
value_or_formula: teleport_player(100)

name: trap6_fire
value_or_formula: 4d6 via fire_dam (resist (d+2)/3 each of resist/oppose; inventory damage)

name: trap7_acid
value_or_formula: 4d6 via acid_dam (same; also minus_ac halves)

name: trap8_slow_dart
value_or_formula: check_hit(125): 1d4 + slow += randint0(20)+20

name: trap9_10_11_dart_STR_DEX_CON
value_or_formula: check_hit(125): 1d4 + do_dec_stat

name: trap12_blind_gas
value_or_formula: blind += randint0(50)+25 (unless pBlind)

name: trap13_confusion_gas
value_or_formula: confused += randint0(20)+10 (unless pConf)

name: trap14_poison_gas
value_or_formula: poisoned += randint0(20)+10 (unless resist/oppose)

name: trap15_paralysis_gas
value_or_formula: paralyzed += randint0(10)+5 unless free action

name: check_hit_trap
value_or_formula: k=randint0(100); k<5 hit, 5..9 miss; else hit if randint1(125) > (ac+to_a)*3/4

name: search_chance
value_or_formula: per adjacent grid (9 grids) independent: randint0(100) < skill_srh; skill_srh/10 if blind or no light; again /10 if confused or hallucinating; finds invisible trap, secret door (+1 exp), chest trap

name: skill_srh
value_or_formula: r_srh + c_srh + x_srh*lev/10 + 5*search pval

name: search_triggers
value_or_formula: 's' cmd (1 pass); each step while in search mode (-10 speed); spontaneous on each step: always if skill_fos>=50 else 1 in (50-skill_fos); 25% per tunnel turn; NOT when holding

name: skill_fos
value_or_formula: r_fos + c_fos + x_fos*lev/10 + 5*search pval

name: walk_onto_hidden_trap
value_or_formula: FEAT_INVIS under you: pick_trap then hit_trap immediately

name: disarm_trap
value_or_formula: j=max(2, skill_dis' - 5) percent success (skill_dis'=skill_dis/10 per blind/no light, /10 confused); fail: if skill_dis'>5 and randint1(skill_dis')>5 retry (prob (i-5)/i) else set off trap (move onto it); exp +5

name: skill_dis
value_or_formula: r_dis + c_dis + adj_dex_dis[DEX] + adj_int_dis[INT] + x_dis*lev/10

name: skill_dev
value_or_formula: r_dev + c_dev + adj_int_dev[INT] + x_dev*lev/10

name: lockpick_door
value_or_formula: j=max(2, skill_dis' - 4*lock_power) where lock_power=feat-FEAT_DOOR_HEAD (1..7); exp +1; retries indefinitely; jammed (>=8) cannot be picked

name: lockpick_chest
value_or_formula: j=max(2, skill_dis' - chest_pval) if pval>0; success exp +1 then trap fires (if any) then contents drop

name: disarm_chest
value_or_formula: needs trap known (found by search); j=max(2, skill_dis'-pval); success exp +pval, pval=-pval (also unlocks); fail: retry if skill>5 and randint1(skill)>5 else chest_trap fires

name: chest_pval
value_or_formula: randint1(chest kind level): small wooden 5, large wooden 15, small iron 25, large iron 35, small steel 45, large steel 55 (cap 55+randint0(5))

name: chest_traps[pval]
value_or_formula: byte table 64 entries; pval1 poison,2/4 STR,3/5 CON,6 none,7-8 poison,9 STR,10 CON,11 poison,12-14 STR+CON,15 summon,16 none,19 paralysis, 25 explode, ...

name: chest_trap_effects
value_or_formula: STR/CON needle: 1d4 + do_dec_stat; poison 10+randint1(20); paralyze 10+randint1(20) unless FA; summon 2+randint1(3); explode 5d8 and contents destroyed

name: chest_contents
value_or_formula: number=(sval%4)*2 slots (small wooden 2, large wooden 2, small iron 4, large iron 4, small steel 6, large steel 6); small chests (sval<4): 75% gold per slot else object; object level |pval|+10; 20 placement tries per slot

name: device_chance
value_or_formula: c=skill_dev (/2 if confused) - min(50, item level); if c<3 then 1/(3-c+1) chance c=3; fail if c<3 or randint1(c)<3 => P(use)=1-2/c (c>=3: (c-2)/c)

name: recharge_fail
value_or_formula: i=(strength+100-itemlevel-10*(pval/number))/15; backfire if i<=1 or one_in_(i); backfire destroys item unless SAFE_RECHARGE (cfg false)

name: recharge_success
value_or_formula: pval += 2+randint1(t), t=strength/(itemlevel+2)+1; scroll strength 60

name: enchant_chance
value_or_formula: per try: roll if randint0(number*100)<100 (missiles /20); fail if randint1(1000)<=table[plus]; table 0,10,50,100,200,300,400,500,700,950,990,992,995,997,999,1000; plus<0 -> chance 0; >15 -> 1000; artifacts also 50% fail

name: enchant_scrolls
value_or_formula: Armor +1 AC try; To-Hit 1; To-Dam 1; *Armor* randint1(3)+2; *Weapon* randint1(3) hit and randint1(3) dam

name: identify
value_or_formula: scroll/staff/rune: always fully identifies chosen item (object_aware+object_known); no failure

name: pseudo_id_sense
value_or_formula: each block: sense iff randint0(sense_base/(plev+sense_div))==0 (IMPROV classes: plev^2+sense_div); pack items only 1 in 5; HEAVY classes judge more

name: stairs
value_or_formula: up/down 1 level; connected stair created; costs one move; quest level blocks down; cfg ironman blocks up

name: level_gen_stairs
value_or_formula: 3-4 down + 1-2 up (classic generator)

name: teleport_range
value_or_formula: teleport_player(dis): distance in [dis/2, dis] first; widens (dis*2, min/2) if no spot in 500 tries; no vault (ICKY) grids

name: phase_door
value_or_formula: teleport_player(10) => 5..10 grids

name: teleport_scroll
value_or_formula: teleport_player(100) => 50..100 grids

name: teleport_level
value_or_formula: town->1; else 50% down (not quest/not 127) else up; ironman nothing

name: deep_descent
value_or_formula: not present in this server

name: searching_slowdown
value_or_formula: searching mode -10 speed

name: boulder_damage_to_player
value_or_formula: 0 (project_p has no GF_BOULDER/GF_BOLT case: default dam=0; LIVE-CONFIRMED set-piece L1 2026-10-23: 5 boulders 0 HP)
